properties.label: PROPOSED DRIVEWAY  12' WIDE
properties.note: Longitudinal pitch 1% min to 12.5% max, lateral 1/8" in 12" to 1/2" in 12" away from the building. PGC Code Sec. 32-151, Table 4 — Site Slope Limitations.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: CONCRETE WALK  5' WIDE
properties.note: Leadwalk from the edge of the driveway to the stoop, 8 ft. Lateral pitch 48:1 max, longitudinal 12:1 max. PGC Code Sec. 32-151, Table 4 — Site Slope Limitations.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: CONCRETE STOOP  8' x 4'
properties.note: Front concrete stoop at the entrance, met by the leadwalk. Riser count and handrail per the architectural plans and the building code.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: CONCRETE SIDEWALK  3' WIDE
properties.note: Public sidewalk across the frontage, inside the front property line. Whether it is to be built, reconstructed or waived is a DPW&T determination at street construction permit.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: PLANTING STRIP  4' WIDE  (STREET TREES)
properties.note: Landscaped strip between the sidewalk and the curb, in the strip dedicated to public use. Street tree species, spacing and clear distances are set by the Landscape Manual and by DPW&T; this shows the STRIP, not a planting schedule.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: CURB AND GUTTER
properties.note: Curb and gutter at the street face of the planting strip, 4 ft outside the front property line, where the frontage meets the travelled way. Depressed through every driveway apron per DPW&T STD. 300.01 note 6.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: PROPOSED 18' DRIVEWAY APRON  PER MCDOT STANDARD
properties.note: Driveway apron at the front property line, at street level, between the curb and the driveway. The mcdot standard govern the depression, jointing and curb cut.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.note: Limits of disturbance — proposed work plus a 10 ft working margin, clipped to the property line.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.note: Positive drainage away from structure at 2% minimum for the first 10 ft.

engineeringGeometry.crsName: NAD83 / Maryland State Plane (US survey feet)

properties.label: FFE
properties.note: Finished floor elevation to be set above the adjacent grade per code.
